title: Modified turbidometric microassay for the measurement of sulfate in plasma and urine
author: Vijayakumar, McWhinney, et al.

steps.title: Dilute plasma and urine samples
steps.instruction: Dilute plasma 1:1 and urine 1:49 with deionized water.

steps.title: Add trichloroacetic acid
steps.instruction: In 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes, add 120 µL of 8 % trichloroacetic acid to 110 µL of each K₂SO₄ standard, diluted plasma, and diluted urine sample.

steps.title: Mix and first centrifugation
steps.instruction: Vortex each tube for 5 seconds, then centrifuge at 16,000 × g for 3 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Second centrifugation of supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a fresh 1.5 mL tube and centrifuge again at 16,000 × g for 3 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect final supernatant for assay
steps.instruction: Use the supernatant from the second centrifugation as the sample in the sulfate microassay.
